type: SaaS infra — HIGHLY RELEVANT pattern (3D hero is optional)
moves: hero: dark, 3-line light-weight headline with ONE word in accent gradient, copy block + 2 CTAs right; 3D magenta ribbon behind

WHY section: left pinned list of 4 features (active = ink, others = pale), right = live product widget per feature (benchmark bars, dotted world map with counters, terminal with progress, line chart) — the product demonstrates itself
dark 'secure' section: giant sphere + 4 icon+title+text rows
white rounded-corner panel 'Powering real-time AI' with case-study cards carousel (logo, category mono label, title, Read case study)
feature list as 2-col arrow rows (Asynchronous jobs →)
mobile: pinned list collapses to stacked; widgets full-width; sphere remains as background
rules_derived: light-weight (300) big display = modern/premium feel without shouting
mono uppercase 13px for ALL labels/meta — instant tech credibility
one accent used only on 1 word per headline + primary CTA
product widgets (fake-live data) are the hero of each feature, not icons
dark/light alternation: dark hero → light features → dark trust → light proof
